subject: Animation
title: Bart vs. Homer: Animation's Greatest Duo
description: Learn Bart vs. Homer: Animation's Greatest Duo in one minute.

hook.text: Bart Simpson was initially the breakout star, but Homer gradually took over as the show's central figure.

buildup.text: Bart represented rebellious youth. His catchphrases and attitude made him a 1990s pop culture icon.

discovery.text: Writers discovered Homer was funnier because his flaws — laziness, greed, love — were more relatable.

twist.text: The shift happened organically. No executive decision changed the focus — writers simply followed the comedy.

climax.text: Homer Simpson was voted the greatest TV character of all time by Entertainment Weekly in 2010.

punchline.text: The lazy dad eclipsed the rebel kid as TV's greatest character.

quiz.question: Why did Homer gradually replace Bart as the central character of The Simpsons?
options: Writers found Homer's relatable adult flaws funnier and richer than Bart's rebellious youth persona
Bart's voice actor left the show
